title: Conflict-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation in Aligned Action Spaces for Cross-Game Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2611.21094v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Zero-shot cross-game generalization aims to consolidate accessible source-game experts into a single vision-language model (VLM) that controls unseen games from raw pixels without target-game parameter updates. While multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) mitigates offline exposure bias and single-game reinforcement learning (RL) overfitting, scaling it to autoregressive VLMs faces two bottlenecks. First, token-to-action misalignment from subword length bias distorts discrete action probabilities and uncertainty margins. Second, multi-teacher policy conflict arises as source teachers under incompatible dynamics issue contradictory closed-loop corrections, causing negative transfer. We propose CAMOPD (Conflict-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation), a post-training framework that resolves multi-teacher policy conflict within an aligned semantic action space. translated_title: 基于对齐动作空间的冲突感知多教师在线策略蒸馏以实现跨游戏泛化
translated_abstract: 零样本跨游戏泛化旨在将可获取的源游戏专家整合到单一视觉语言模型（VLM）中，使其能够从原始像素控制未见过的游戏，而无需对目标游戏进行参数更新。虽然多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）能够缓解离线暴露偏差和单游戏强化学习（RL）过拟合问题，但将其扩展到自回归VLM面临两个瓶颈。第一，子词长度偏差导致的token与动作不对齐会扭曲离散动作概率和不确定性边界。第二，多教师策略冲突会产生，因为源教师在不相容的动态环境下会发出矛盾的闭环修正，从而导致负迁移。我们提出了CAMOPD（冲突感知多教师在线策略蒸馏），这是一个在语义对齐的动作空间内解决多教师策略冲突的训练后框架。CAMOPD首先使用完整动作对齐来规范化命令补全……
tldr: 提出CAMOPD训练后框架，通过在对齐的语义动作空间中解决多教师策略冲突与token-动作不对齐问题，实现视觉语言模型从原始像素零样本泛化控制未见过的游戏。
en_tdlr: CAMOPD resolves multi-teacher policy conflicts within an aligned semantic action space, enabling vision-language models to zero-shot generalize across unseen games from raw pixels without target-game parameter updates.
